fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-19 11:30 to 2026-10-20 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: one, unchanged (no new escalation this cycle).
- Fact: the standard says Field and Type names are snake_case, but all 151 Type, View, Composition, Blueprint and Vocabulary names in use are kebab-case (srs#236, P0, blocks the gate).
- Why it matters: whichever you pick becomes what third parties are told to follow; changing the written standard is yours, not the group's.
- Options and consequences: (1) rename all 151: text stays true, but it reaches the generator, every rendered page and every by-name reference. (2) keep Field names snake_case, document Type and Vocabulary names as kebab-case, split the shared `name` Field: matches practice, small change. (3) grandfather the 151, enforce only for new names: no rewrite, rule stays half-enforced.
- Recommendation: option 2. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (srs#236 stays blocked until you do).
- Record: proposed decision b80d2d1e (3 days). Detail: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/issues/236
Still waiting on you: srs-vscode#135 (owner-merge, open since 10-12; its check-schema-drift check is red on the head, so it needs a fix before a merge); srs-rust#861 (doctor over MCP, split not yet filed); srs-rust#683 (parked behind ratified decision 31e9fd27, RFC next).

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified this cycle, no group session held. Decision 04b78189 (one definition filename scheme, srs-rust#1209) has the reviewer's assent on a merged PR (srs-rust#1405) and its record is now on master (srs-programme#154). It was still in `draft`, so the ratify agenda could not see it; this run moved it and b80d2d1e to `proposed` through the CLI, and it is first on the next session. No owner ruling for this group was found in the group log this cycle.

3. Done: 0 group PRs merged this cycle (the last merges were 10-17: srs#938, srs-rust#1410).

4. Stuck or lost: no group PR is open except srs-vscode#135 (owner-merge, red check-schema-drift). needs-input: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, srs#236. No red gates reported by runs, no claims to release. Gap found: records created as proposals were left in `draft`, which hides them from the session agenda; the builder and steward should transition to `proposed` when filing.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 0 open delegated. Pause state: running (reports 10-18 and 10-19 carry a thumbs-up).
5b. Awaiting ratification: decision 04b78189 (proposed from today, ready, about 4 days since filed) and escalation b80d2d1e (proposed, 3 days, waiting on your ruling). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready and unparked issues in the code repos: 2 workable (srs-rust#1132, P2; srs-vscode#133, P2), plus srs-vscode#134 (already PR #135). Three more ready ones are stopped on needs-input (srs-rust#861, #683, #1198). srs and srs-web: 0. No local priorities set. Top 3 in the Builder's order: srs-rust#1132, srs-vscode#133, then the P2 backlog. Open group PRs in flight: 0 delegated. Budget left: 10. **Queue running dry: 2 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding.** New work could come from the spec-to-implementation drift list, conformance gaps in ratified rulings, or unparking #1198 once SP-78 is ranked. What waits on the owner: the decision above, srs-vscode#135. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-19 run filed 0; nothing new yet today (the 12:00 check follows this report).

6b. Exercises: none open in the group log.

7. What we learned: the pause rule held and released as designed: two thumbs-up restored the group within a day, though nothing was merged in the interim, so the pause cost a cycle of throughput. A proposal left in `draft` is invisible to the session agenda, so a ready decision waited an extra cycle: the lifecycle step belongs in the filing routine. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are well over 10, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) stays ready to unpark; flagged again for you.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation was raised: the only item outside the boundary, srs#236, is already open as proposed decision b80d2d1e, so no second record was filed. Decisions 04b78189 and b80d2d1e were moved from draft to proposed so the ratify agenda can see them; no ratification was done because the session tooling works from a master worktree that did not yet carry the proposed state.
